title: Add structured output sample with JSON schema + validation/retry loop
author: Renee Sullivan
release_notes: - Added runnable structured output sample that validates model output against a JSON schema and retries on invalid JSON/validation failures.
body: Summary: This PR adds a new runnable example that demonstrates Redwood structured output using JSON Schema constraints, plus robust client-side parsing/validation and a bounded retry strategy when the model emits invalid JSON or fails schema validation. Motivation: We continue to see users copy/paste “JSON mode” examples and then hit parse errors or subtly invalid payloads in production (see SUP-18436). This sample is meant to be the canonical “copy/paste works” reference for schema-constrained output + safe handling (validate, log, retry, and fallback). What’s included: (1) A small app under examples/structured-output-json-schema/ that requests a typed object (travel itinerary) using structured output, with the schema checked in alongside the code; (2) A validation layer using a JSON Schema validator (Ajv) to catch both invalid JSON and schema mismatches; (3) A bounded retry loop (default 2 attempts) that feeds back validation errors to the model and re-requests a corrected JSON payload; (4) A README with setup, expected output, common failure modes, and notes on model support variability. Not included / deliberate choices: The sample uses non-streaming responses for clarity. The README calls out that streaming requires incremental buffering and defers parsing until a final event; we link to the streaming guide sample PR for that canonical pattern. How to run: export REDWOOD_API_KEY=... (optionally REDWOOD_BASE_URL and REDWOOD_MODEL), then run pnpm i && pnpm start from the example directory. Definition-of-done checklist: copy/paste runbook, schema file checked in, deterministic validator behavior, logs show failure reasons, retry path covered by tests, and docs terminology matches PM sign-off language for “structured output” (not “JSON mode”). Screenshots/Output: README includes a successful run and an intentionally-failed run (schema violation) demonstrating the retry and eventual success. Follow-ups: Once the docs guide lands, we should link this sample from the structured output docs page and keep schema/testcases aligned with the shared structured-output test matrix.
commits: examples: add itinerary JSON schema + Ajv validator
examples: implement retry loop with validation error feedback
docs: add README, troubleshooting, and expected output
tests: add unit tests for parse/validate/retry behavior
conversation: Wei Chen (review): Can we make the README explicit that you should validate client-side even when using structured output? We should avoid implying “guaranteed valid JSON.”

Renee Sullivan (author): Yep — added a “Guarantees & expectations” section: structured output constrains generation, but apps must still parse + validate; retry is recommended for high reliability. Also linked to PM-413 wording.

Ibrahim Khan (review): The retry prompt should include the validator errors but avoid dumping the entire schema. Otherwise we’ll teach users to send huge prompts. Can you keep it minimal and deterministic?

Renee Sullivan (author): Updated retry.ts to send: (a) the JSON parse error or ajv error list; (b) the expected top-level keys; (c) a short instruction to output ONLY a JSON object. No schema blob. Added a unit test to assert we don’t include the full schema.
Leila Farouk (review): Please add coverage for the “valid JSON but invalid schema” case and ensure we cap attempts and return a typed error so callers can fallback gracefully.

Renee Sullivan (author): Added retry.test.ts cases for: invalid JSON -> success on retry, schema mismatch -> success on retry, and permanent failure -> throws StructuredOutputValidationError with lastError + attemptCount. README now shows a simple fallback pattern.
Brian Murphy (review): Minor: in src/index.ts, please log the raw model text only at debug, since people may copy this into apps with sensitive data. Also add a note about redacting logs.
Renee Sullivan (author): Done — gated raw output behind DEBUG=1 and added a short note in README under “Operational tips.”
Wei Chen (approval): Approved. Terminology matches docs sign-off and the sample is copy/pasteable.
Ibrahim Khan (approval): Approved. Retry behavior is bounded and examples align with validation guidance.
Leila Farouk (approval): Approved after tests; looks good.
